hi :) i think i got this setup and working properly. thanks claude! had to put those $100 of free fable 5 credits to use somehow. ive only used 15 dollars for this whole thing so far though, so maybe ill be able to make it super cool with all of my remaining credits. dont want it to be a vibe coded mess though. 

this is a public diary where i will be a bit vulnerable and mainly maintain it as a way to look back at my life and stay present in my mind.

yesterday a friend and i read through the unabomber manifesto and talked about it for hours. i think ted k (dont ask me to spell his last name) had some incredibly strong points about our current society, but ive ultimately been groomed by the system so much that i will never be the revolutionary he is calling out for. instead i will make do with what i have and what i can do :)

i have the option to color code all of these posts. i think i will set up my rules for what it means now in this post. this post is probably gonna be a lot longer than most, just because its the first one. i love times new roman. what a great font.

blue = sad day
green = happy day
yellow = very very great day
orange = stressful day
red = awful day
purple = im not sure
grey = neutral day

i will try to put a song with each day too. whatever song im enjoying the mostt at time of writing. maybe there will be duplicates. idk. i thinjk this is super cool though :) im excited to fill it out! hopefully claude didnt write any code that makes this the most vulnerable site of all time that puts my entire credit card and ssn on the public web!

2026-07-29.text:
hello! today has been a mostly good day. i added some more stuff to this site. i really like that i landed on this as a creative project. ive been struggling for a while to find one that actually hits for me, and i think this is it. ive always loved multi-media works, but the issue is that you have to be good at Multiple Mediums. im good with a computer. im gonna keep adding pages and references and whatever else bullshit to it for forever. the best thing about this is im committing to nothing. its like a minecraft world. i have it bookmarked, i can add whatever to it whenever im feeling bored, and over the years ill be able to look back at everything ive made :)

this website is definitely inspired a lot by floor796 and the asheley catacombs. also house of leaves. i think the blue text at the top is a nice touch. maybe i shouldnt be writing that here. oh well.

its also weird because i feel that im writing for an audience, but in reality, i cant imagine many people besides me (and whoever is stalking me. i see you.) are reading tthis. same with the drawings. and the junk drawer. im learning how to be myself "on stage" while im not actually on stage. i think itll help me be a lot more open emotionally as i move forward. its cool :)

ive been very interested in buddhism recently, i dont think ill ever consider myself one, but i do think they are the closest to getting it right. i just dont believe in 'naming' or even really qualifying these supernatural ideas. is supernatural the right worD? idk. existential

i like lucy bedroque a lot. im listening to fete de la vanille as we speak. im not sure i have much more to write about right now. im excited to move back to pittsburgh (6 days!!!)

image attached is a thumbnail i made today. no images have touched me today so i am choosing this.

see ya tomorrow

hi! today has been very good. nothing overly crazy, but just overall really good. my mental is very clear right now.

as i type this im listening to Yard by Slow Pulp for the first time, my friend cole recommended me one of their songs and i really liked it so now im gonna give them a proper listen. shoutout to cole too

im really trying to live that "act like how you want to be" lifestyle. part of it makes me feel like im going crazy. i just have this constant urge to delete everything. i think about everybody elses opinions of everything. or at least i can feel those thoughts coming to me. ive gotten good at acknowledging the thoughts and allowing them to pass.

i think i got my sign today. that made me happy.

today on tiktok i posted, my face, a skyblock shitpost that i made, and a video of me talking. every inch of my skin crawls whenever i think about it. i want to delete it all. i wont. that is the person i want to be. i want to be as outwardly expressive as i am internally. that will attract good people into my life. i will not attract good people into my life if i continue to be the solitary room dweller that i am currently. 

excited as usual to move back to pittsburgh. i wanna hike sooooo bad. tomorrow is the launch of ravengard, i wonder if this will be a "throwback" in 5 years because ravengard turns into the most popular hypixel game of all time. i dont think thats gonna happen LOL

i finished evangelion today, at least the anime. i absolutely loved the ending. probably the best show ive ever watched. the only thing i can think of that would compete would be attack on titan but i would instantly put evangelion on top so i guess yeah thats the best show ive ever watched. im excited to watch the movies. gonna give it a bit though. i honestly need to be consuming more, ive been so caught up on making this site and adding to it. 

also, to this site today i added a message board for people to send in anonymous (or not) messages as well as a page where i get a random image from wikimedia commons and i can assign a song to it and why. both just random thoughts that i turned into real. ive also decided that i need to properly learn html. i know how it functions but i dont know how it Works, you know? if i want to expand and expand this website like the labyrinth I want it to be, i need to learn how to build t he walls myself. 

I think that is all for today. I am enjoying typing in here, it is very peaceful. Journaling is great. I started my day with 5 minutes of meditation today. I think tomorrow I will do 6. I dont know why I am capitalizing every I right now. It just feels good. Talk to u tomorrow!
